title: Bridging the Culture Gap: A Framework for LLM-Driven Socio-Cultural Localization of Math Word Problems in Low-Resource Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM mathematical reasoning performance by substituting English-centric entities (personal names, organizations, and currencies) with culturally relevant native equivalents in translated math word problems, and comparing accuracy (Numeric Match) between the English-centric and localized versions.
